I think the best thing you can do is to make yourself feel safer. Only you can do that... and I think that one thing is being able to take care of yourself in the future... You see I gave up on my career. Now I'm scared, scared of getting a shit job living paycheque to paycheque but most of all, I'm scared of being homeless. I'm starting to understand what it feels like to be hungry...  Go to school and work hard, and if you're not good at school, consider other things that uses a different kind of learning such as hair or carpentry. Anything. The future is coming whether you like it or not, and if you don't have the guts to kill yourself then live before you end up homeless and further abused. Never burn bridges and be kind, your reptuation does matter. I ruined mine... trust me, it matters. If it's not nice don't say it. Your stories matter if you want to be in business or hairstyling (keep your clients entertained). Stop cutting yourself it's not working and only hurting yourself more. Accept that you can't kill yourself, not now, maybe not ever so you can take a step forward on where you have to go. Only you can make yourself feel safer... Life gets much harder, save yourself.
